_help: brain can be 'ollama' (free, runs on your PC), 'online' (Groq or Gemini, free tiers, needs a key), 'claude' (paid, smarter, needs a key) or 'demo' (no AI, just to test the wiring).
_kb_help: Folder where your lucent-kb repository is cloned. Relative paths are from this folder.
_online_help: For brain 'online'. Groq: url https://api.groq.com/openai/v1, model llama-3.3-70b-versatile. Gemini: url https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai, model gemini-2.5-flash. Key in env ONLINE_AI_KEY.
_claude_key_help: Do NOT paste the key here. Set it as a Windows environment variable called ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
_whatsapp_provider_help: 'whatsmcp' = the WhatsMCP service you already use (default). 'meta' = Meta's official Cloud API directly.

whatsmcp._help: API key goes in the environment variable WAMCP_KEY. account_id is shown in your WhatsMCP dashboard (or run: python run.py whatsmcp-accounts).

whatsapp._help: allowed_numbers: ONLY these numbers can command the team, e.g. ["919812345678"]. Leave the rest empty unless you use provider 'meta'. Meta token goes in WHATSAPP_TOKEN.
